answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. The terrace decay curve is applied at each close, nadir records the drop, and sable recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A 350 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
